create_mephisto_project: create a new Mephisto project with a given project name using the database interface
find_mephisto_tasks: find Mephisto tasks by task name or project id using the database find_tasks method
create_mephisto_task_run: create a new task run for a given task with requester and provider type parameters
find_mephisto_units: find Mephisto units by task id, assignment id, worker id, or status using the database
grant_worker_qualification: grant a qualification to a worker by qualification id and worker id with an optional value
